_about: Extra catalogue tags for City Sample Crowd assets that their names and folders do not carry. Faces: the canonical skin tones (SkinToneId) each face can represent — each face is a cell of the shared FaceColorAtlas (AtlasSelector = face index - 1; female cells are the top two rows, male the bottom two), read off the exported atlas (.debug/human/atlas/face.png); every tone has at least one face per sex. Hair: the shape a canonical hair style asks for (`swept`, `cropped`). Applied by audit_character_assets.py and by scripts/foundry/tag-catalogue.mjs.
